question: The Government of India has approved the Centrally Sponsored Scheme ‘Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN)' for providing one hot cooked meal in Government and Government - aided Schools from 2021-22 to ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025-26.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman** (PM POSHAN) scheme aims to improve the nutritional status of children in the age group of **6 months to 6 years**, adolescent girls, pregnant women, and lactating mothers. 
 
• The scheme was launched in **March 2018 **and is implemented by the** Ministry of Women and Child Development. **
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance to States/UTs for the implementation of various interventions such as **supplementary nutrition, counselling, and growth monitoring.**
 
• The **Government of India **has approved the PM POSHAN for providing one** hot cooked meal **in Government and Government - aided Schools from** 2021-22 to 2025-26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The n**ational midday meal program** in schools, often known as the** midday meal scheme**, was superseded by the PM-POSHAN initiative.
 
• It also includes pre-primary students from **balvatikas,** or youngsters in the age range of **three to five.**
 
• Supplementary nourishment is provided by the initiative to children in **high-anemia prevalence** areas and aspirational districts.
 
• The central government recently asked union territory authorities and state governments to look into the potential of implementing **millets **under the PM POSHAN Scheme.
